postTitle: Fee Optimization: The Silent Drag on Your Returns
topic: One statement fee can sit on top of several layers of cost

assumptions.notes: Illustrative layers from the blog's ranges: active fund expense ratio 1.0% (blog: 0.5 to 1.5%), platform 0.3% (0.15 to 0.45%), adviser 1.0% (0.5 to 1.5%), in fund trading and tax drag about 0.3% (blog: 0.3 to 0.6% trading). Total 2.6%, inside the blog's 'could easily total 2 to 3%'. Low cost passive about 0.1% (blog: 0.1 to 0.3%).

barStory.disclosure: Illustrative layers. Totals vary by product, platform and country.
